sources.title: Price Details: AION UT (GAC Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Choose Model: Premium $31,990.00; Luxury $35,990.00; then a postcode field. The page does not say whether these are before or after on-road costs.

sources.title: AION UT (GAC Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. 'Drive Away Price: from $31,990 AUD, Exclusive for Q4 2026 Orders'; footnote: the national drive away offer is available to orders placed between 1 October 2026 and 31 December 2026, unless otherwise extended; a $1,000 deposit is required. WLTP 430 km.

sources.title: Price Details: AION V (GAC Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Choose Model: Premium $42,590.00; Luxury $44,590.00; then a postcode field. The page does not say whether these are before or after on-road costs.

sources.title: AION V (GAC Australia)
sources.supports: Opened 2026-11-05. Cashback Offer footnote: only for customers who place an order for the AION V and take delivery by 30 November 2026, minimum deposit $1,000, applied at point of sale as a reduction to the vehicle price. The amount and the price basis were not visible in the text read.

availability.note: Page invites orders placed 1 October to 31 December 2026 with a $1,000 deposit; allocation, stock and delivery not stated.

fields.label: Price
fields.note: GAC's AION UT page describes $31,990 as a national drive away offer price for orders 1 October to 31 December 2026, while the catalogue records the figure as MSRP before on-road costs. The price pages state no basis. The basis conflict is unresolved, so the value and date are retained unchanged.
